ALG.flavor: A fennec fox with very big ears. It hears everything.
ALG.passive: the fox listens — {team} hear the pass before it happens.

ARG.flavor: Three stars and a sun that will not stop shining.
ARG.passive: the sun beams — {team} free kicks feel a little golden.

AUS.flavor: A kangaroo that never learned to walk backwards.
AUS.passive: the roo bounces — {team} only ever hop forward.

AUT.flavor: A tidy eagle between two red stripes. Very organised.
AUT.passive: the eagle tidies up — {team} loose balls sort themselves out.

BEL.flavor: The famous little red devil. Mostly well behaved.
BEL.passive: the badge grins — {team} shots take a cheeky bend.

BIH.flavor: Golden lilies on blue. Small flowers, big hearts.
BIH.passive: the lilies bloom — {team} play braver at home.

BRA.flavor: Five stars. They are not shy about it.
BRA.passive: the stars twinkle — {team} skill moves feel like samba.

CAN.flavor: A maple leaf. Polite, and unbreakable.
CAN.passive: the leaf holds firm — {team} never mind a cold snap.

CIV.flavor: An elephant. It remembers every match.
CIV.passive: the elephant remembers — {team} learn from every rebound.

COD.flavor: A leopard mid-prowl. Quiet paws, loud finish.
COD.passive: the leopard prowls — {team} counters arrive on soft feet.

COL.flavor: A condor riding yellow, blue and red.
COL.passive: the condor soars — {team} long balls hang a beat longer.

CPV.flavor: Ten islands, one badge, zero fear.
CPV.passive: the sharks circle — {team} sense a loose ball in the box.

CRO.flavor: The famous checkerboard. Every square counted twice.
CRO.passive: the squares line up — {team} passes click into place.

CUW.flavor: Stars on ocean blue. Small island, big splash.
CUW.passive: the stars sparkle — {team} play with holiday feet.

CZE.flavor: A lion with two tails. Twice the swish.
CZE.passive: both tails swish — {team} always get a second look.

ECU.flavor: A badge the colour of sunrise over the Andes.
ECU.passive: the mountain air helps — {team} never seem to puff.

EGY.flavor: A badge as old as the pyramids. Well, nearly.
EGY.passive: the Pharaohs nod — {team} stand tall like monuments.

ENG.flavor: Three lions on a shirt. Still dreaming.
ENG.passive: the lions roar — {team} believe right up to the whistle.

ESP.flavor: A royal crest with a lot going on. All of it wins.
ESP.passive: the crown gleams — {team} keep the ball like treasure.

FRA.flavor: A rooster who crows first and asks later.
FRA.passive: the rooster crows — {team} wake up fast after half time.

GER.flavor: An eagle and four stars. Built to specification.
GER.passive: the eagle inspects — {team} finish what they measure.

GHA.flavor: One black star. It shines anyway.
GHA.passive: the star glows — {team} shine brightest under the lights.

HAI.flavor: A palm tree that has weathered every storm.
HAI.passive: the palm bends, never breaks — {team} bounce back quick.

IRN.flavor: A badge quick as a cheetah. Blink and it's gone.
IRN.passive: the cheetah stretches — {team} break faster than they look.

IRQ.flavor: Lions from the land of two rivers.
IRQ.passive: the rivers run — {team} keep flowing forward.

JOR.flavor: A new badge at the big dance. It practised in the mirror.
JOR.passive: the badge beams — {team} play like it's the best day ever.

JPN.flavor: A crow with three legs. Extra balance, obviously.
JPN.passive: the crow balances — {team} first touches land just so.

KOR.flavor: A tiger in mid-leap. It skipped the warm-up.
KOR.passive: the tiger leaps — {team} press before you're ready.

KSA.flavor: A green falcon with excellent eyesight.
KSA.passive: the falcon spots gaps — {team} passes find keyholes.

MAR.flavor: An Atlas lion who climbed a mountain to get here.
MAR.passive: the lion stands guard — {team} defend like a mountain pass.

MEX.flavor: An eagle perched on a cactus. Comfortable anywhere.
MEX.passive: the eagle settles — {team} feel at home in any stadium.

NED.flavor: An orange lion. The paint was on purpose.
NED.passive: the lion swaggers — {team} try the fancy thing first.

NOR.flavor: A lion in the cold. It didn't notice.
NOR.passive: the north wind pushes — {team} finish strong in the rain.

NZL.flavor: A silver fern. Delicate looking. It is not.
NZL.passive: the fern unfurls — {team} grow into every match.

PAN.flavor: A badge that bridges two oceans.
PAN.passive: the canal connects — {team} link up from box to box.

PAR.flavor: A lion under a star, guarding the badge.
PAR.passive: the guard lion watches — {team} sniff out sneaky passes.

POR.flavor: An old explorer's sphere. It has seen the whole map.
POR.passive: the sphere spins — {team} shots come from strange places.

QAT.flavor: A maroon badge, calm as a desert evening.
QAT.passive: the desert cools — {team} stay patient when it's tense.

RSA.flavor: A badge with a rainbow behind it. Always.
RSA.passive: the rainbow arcs — {team} chipped passes look extra pretty.

SCO.flavor: A prickly thistle. Handle with care.
SCO.passive: the thistle prickles — {team} are no fun to tackle.

SEN.flavor: A lion of Teranga. Fierce, and a wonderful host.
SEN.passive: the lion welcomes you in — then {team} take the ball back.

SUI.flavor: A white cross, punctual to the second.
SUI.passive: the badge keeps time — {team} never miss a kickoff beat.

SWE.flavor: Three crowns. One would have been fine.
SWE.passive: the crowns sit level — {team} keep a cool blue head.

TUN.flavor: An eagle of Carthage, older than most trophies.
TUN.passive: the old eagle circles — {team} wait for the right moment.

TUR.flavor: A crescent moon and star. Night games feel special.
TUR.passive: the moon rises — {team} glow in evening kickoffs.

URU.flavor: Four stars on a small badge. Punching up is tradition.
URU.passive: the stars stack — {team} play bigger than they look.

USA.flavor: Stars, stripes, and a lot of running.
USA.passive: the stripes streak — {team} run all day and ask for extra.

UZB.flavor: The Huma bird. Legend says it never lands.
UZB.passive: the Huma flies on — {team} never stop moving.
